The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the effectiveness of the encryption methods mentioned in the paragraph: The text describes the implementation of AES-256 bit encryption. AES-256 is currently considered highly effective and secure. It uses a 256-bit key length, which provides a vast number of possible key combinations (2^256), making it practically immune to brute-force attacks with current and foreseeable computing technology. As noted in the text, it is widely accepted by security experts and government agencies as a standard for protecting sensitive data. Therefore, the assessment is that the encryption method is very effective for ensuring confidentiality and security against unauthorized access.
